description: Na₂MgGe₂(SbO₅)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.84 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.89 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MgO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SbO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent SbO₅ square pyramids,  a cornercorner with one GeO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one GeO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.11 Å. There are two inequivalent Ge sites. In the first Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SbO₅ square pyramids, and  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 48-62°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.80 Å. In the second Ge site, Ge is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted GeO₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent SbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent SbO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 56-68°. There are a spread of Ge-O bond distances ranging from 1.76-1.87 Å. There are two inequivalent Sb sites. In the first Sb site, Sb is bonded to six O atoms to form SbO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one SbO₅ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ trigonal pyramid, and corners with two equivalent GeO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.11 Å. In the second Sb site, Sb is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted SbO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SbO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent GeO₄ trigonal pyramids, and corners with three equivalent MgO₄ trigonal pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 45°. There are a spread of Sb-O bond distances ranging from 2.02-2.68 Å. There are ten inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two Sb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramid. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramid, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramid. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra and corners with three ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ge, and one Sb atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Mg, one Ge, and one Sb atom to form distorted ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaMgGeSb tetrahedra and corners with three ONa₂GeSb trigonal pyramids.
